zones.label: Drink Water
zones.summary: Water helps the body cool down, move, and think clearly.
facts: Drink regularly, especially after active play.
A reusable bottle can make water easy to reach.
Thirst is one body signal that it is time to drink.

zones.label: Eat Many Foods
zones.summary: A variety of foods gives the body different kinds of help.
facts: Fruits, vegetables, grains, protein foods, and dairy or alternatives all contribute.
Families enjoy healthy foods in many cultural traditions.
Hunger signals can tell us it is time to eat.

zones.label: Wash & Care
zones.summary: Personal-care habits help bodies stay clean and comfortable.
facts: Soap and water remove germs from hands.
Brushing teeth protects teeth and gums.
Daily routines become easier with practice.

zones.label: Move & Play
zones.summary: Movement helps muscles, bones, brains, and feelings.
facts: Active play can include running, dancing, climbing, or wheeling.
Every body can find enjoyable ways to move.
Moving each day can improve energy and mood.

zones.label: Balance Tech
zones.summary: Healthy technology use leaves room for sleep, family, learning, and play.
facts: A trusted adult can help choose safe activities.
Screens are one part of a balanced day.
Taking breaks gives eyes and bodies time to move.

quiz.question: Which helper is especially important after running or playing outside?
Which helper includes fruits, vegetables, grains, and protein foods?
Which helper includes soap, toothbrushing, and clean towels?
Which helper can build strength and lift your mood?
Which helper reminds us to make room for family time and active play?
